**v1.4.0: the map and the log, see-through over the game.**
- **The overlay** (off by default; new, and not tried in the game yet). The zone map around your wizard and the newest lines of the log are drawn see-through over Wizard101, borderless or windowed, so you don't need the dashboard open beside the game. Exclusive full screen is not supported. Switch it on in Settings > THE OVERLAY, from the tray menu's "Overlay over the game on/off", or with Windows+4.
- **It stays out of the way.** It shows only while Wizard101 is the window in front, and hides the moment you Alt+Tab or minimise. Clicks go through it to the game, and it never takes the focus.
- **The bot can't see it.** Windows keeps it out of every screen capture: the bot's own screen reading, your screenshots, recordings and the bug report's pictures. Each time you switch it on, a small pink square flashes on the game for a moment while the bot checks this. If the bot can see it anyway, it stays off and says why in debug.log.
- **Settings:** a corner for each part (or Off), the map's size, the log's lines, width and text size, and the dark box behind them and how solid it is. dashboard.ini [overlay] can move each part by pixels and set how much of the zone the map shows.
- **Needs** Windows 10 version 2004 or newer and the vision helper. AutoFarmer\LIVE_CHECKS.txt step 3.9 says what to try.
- **Keys:** if you had already given Windows+4 to another action, it stays that action's key, and the overlay has no key until you change one of them in the dashboard's Keys tab.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install, including ones set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips (they show v1.2.0, v1.2.1 or v1.3.0), so the version.txt step from v1.1.0's notes isn't needed. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
